# SigMF 1.2.6 upstream schema fixtures

These schema files are reproduced unmodified from the SigMF repository at
the [`v1.2.6` tag](https://github.com/sigmf/SigMF/tree/v1.2.6):

- [`sigmf-schema.json`](https://github.com/sigmf/SigMF/blob/v1.2.6/sigmf-schema.json)
- [`collection-schema.json`](https://github.com/sigmf/SigMF/blob/v1.2.6/collection-schema.json)

The original `LICENSE.md` is included in this directory. The schema files are
licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Their SHA-256 digests are:

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `sigmf-schema.json` | `1995bd03cd1486e116c7f72acb46d020ac442d12fa59e4c270d41beed536c79a` |
| `collection-schema.json` | `46358666a6e3ea10912bd13415e55869efa05197866cdcd0647b5c2930625e15` |

These are upstream artifacts, not the library's semantic conformance rules.
Known differences between the schemas and the specification prose are
documented in [`docs/sigmf-conformance.md`](../../../../../docs/sigmf-conformance.md).
